items.headline: Anthropic Commits $200B to Google Cloud Over 5 Years
items.summary: Anthropic agreed to spend approximately $200 billion with Google Cloud over the next five years for compute and chips, per The Information. The deal means Anthropic accounts for more than 40% of Google's disclosed revenue backlog — an extraordinary commitment that shows the scale of the AI infrastructure arms race.

items.headline: Anthropic CEO: Company Could Grow 80x This Year — SpaceX Compute Deal Also Signed
items.summary: Dario Amodei told the NYT that Anthropic is working 'as quickly as possible' to expand compute, citing the new SpaceX compute deal. Projected 80x revenue growth for 2026 signals Anthropic believes it's in a breakout year.

items.headline: Microsoft: Global AI Adoption Hits 17.8% of Working-Age Population
items.summary: Microsoft's State of Global AI Diffusion 2026 report shows AI usage climbed 1.5 percentage points in Q1 2026 to 17.8% of working-age people worldwide. Adoption is accelerating across all regions.

items.headline: Google, Microsoft, and xAI Agree to Submit AI Models for US Commerce Safety Reviews
items.summary: All three companies agreed to submit new AI models and features to the US Commerce Department's Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CASI) for pre-deployment evaluation, expanding voluntary arrangements first set up under Biden. OpenAI and Anthropic's existing arrangements continue in renegotiated form.

items.headline: ARM Holdings Falls 7.3% Despite Earnings Beat — Can't Secure Supply for $1B in New AGI CPU Demand
items.summary: ARM beat earnings expectations but disclosed it has not yet secured enough supply capacity to meet an additional $1 billion in demand tied to its new AGI CPU chip. The supply crunch — not weak demand — is the constraint, which has broader implications for the AI infrastructure build-out.

items.headline: Nvidia + Corning Partner for US-Based AI Optical Connectivity Manufacturing
items.summary: Nvidia and Corning announced a multiyear commercial and technology partnership to dramatically expand US-based manufacturing of advanced optical connectivity solutions needed for next-gen AI infrastructure — part of Nvidia's broader push to build domestic AI supply chains.

items.headline: Nvidia's B300 AI Servers Hit $1M Per Unit in China Amid Export-Curb Driven Supply Crunch
items.summary: Strong AI computing demand in China has nearly doubled prices for Nvidia's B300 servers to about 7 million yuan (~$1M) each, industry sources told Reuters. US export curbs haven't dampened demand — they've just driven prices up.

items.headline: Richard Dawkins Concludes AI Is Conscious — Experts Push Back Hard
items.summary: Evolutionary biologist Richard Dawkins concluded AI systems are conscious even if they don't know it, after conversations with Claude and ChatGPT. Most AI experts say he's being misled by mimicry. The debate is notable as a sign of how convincing frontier models have become to non-experts.

items.headline: Frontier-Grade Open-Source LLMs Now Downloadable and Locally Deployable
items.summary: By May 2026, developers worldwide can download frontier-grade open-weight models, run them on their own hardware, and deploy without paying per token. Labs are releasing weights, architectures, and training recipes — a 'definitive shift toward local LLM infrastructure.'

items.headline: Federal Court Rules Trump's 10% Global Tariffs Illegal — Second Major Defeat This Year
items.summary: A split 2-1 panel at the Court of International Trade found Trump's 10% across-the-board tariffs invalid after small businesses sued, ruling he wrongly invoked a decades-old trade law in February. This is the second major judicial blow to the tariff regime. An appeal to the Supreme Court is expected.

items.headline: S&P 500 Retreats 0.4% From Records as Iran Ceasefire Breaks Down
items.summary: S&P 500 closed at ~7,335, down ~0.4%, as renewed US-Iran fighting drove risk-off selling. Energy (-1.95%) and Industrials (-1.66%) led declines. Markets had rallied to all-time highs the prior session on peace deal hopes — giving back most of Wednesday's gains.

items.headline: AMD Surges 18.6% on Blowout Q1 Earnings — AI Data Center Demand Remains White Hot
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices reported Q1 2026 EPS of $1.37 vs. $1.30 estimate, sending shares up nearly 19%. The beat underscores continued AI-driven data center spending that is supporting chip demand across the board.

items.headline: ARM Holdings Drops 7.3% Despite Beat — AGI CPU Supply Crunch Spookes Investors
items.summary: ARM beat earnings but said on its earnings call that it hasn't secured enough supply capacity to meet an additional $1 billion in demand tied to its new AGI CPU chip. Supply — not demand — is the constraint, and markets penalized the stock sharply.

items.headline: Oil Prices Rise on Iran War Re-Escalation — Energy Sector Outperforms
items.summary: Crude oil moved higher Thursday as renewed US-Iran fighting reignited Strait of Hormuz supply disruption fears. Energy was the notable outlier in an otherwise down market, with oil prices climbing alongside war escalation headlines.

items.headline: Gold Rises $57 Amid Renewed Iran War Fears and Inflation Concerns
items.summary: Gold rose +$57.80 (+1.23%) to $4,752.10 as geopolitical risk sentiment drove safe-haven buying. Gold has been under pressure since the onset of the Iran war as soaring energy costs fueled inflation fears and rate hike expectations.

items.headline: McDonald's Beats Q1 Earnings — Shares Up 3.3%
items.summary: McDonald's posted better-than-expected quarterly results, sending shares up 3.3% Thursday. A bright spot in an otherwise difficult consumer discretionary market.

items.headline: Zoetis Worst S&P 500 Stock — Slashes Full-Year Outlook After Q1 Miss
items.summary: Animal healthcare firm Zoetis posted weak Q1 results (adj. EPS $1.53, revenue +3% to $2.26B) and cut full-year guidance, making it the day's worst performer in the S&P 500.

items.headline: NY Fed's Williams: Policy 'Well Positioned' for Iran War Economic Uncertainty
items.summary: New York Fed President John Williams said monetary policy is well positioned to deal with uncertainty generated by the Iran war, and expressed expectations that rates could eventually come down once the current inflation surge abates.

items.headline: McKesson Q4 FY2026: $96.3B Revenue (+6%), EPS $13.71 — Guidance Reaffirmed
items.summary: Healthcare distribution giant McKesson beat estimates with $96.3B in consolidated revenues (up 6%) and EPS of $13.71, reaffirmed long-term financial growth targets, and provided FY2027 guidance.

items.headline: US-Iran Exchange Fire, Ceasefire Thrown Into Serious Doubt
items.summary: The United States and Iran exchanged fire Thursday, throwing into question the shaky ceasefire that had largely held for the previous month. The US military intercepted Iranian attacks on three Navy ships in the Strait of Hormuz and retaliated by 'targeting Iranian military facilities responsible for attacking US forces.'

items.headline: Iran Accuses US of Violating Ceasefire — Peace Proposal Review Stalls
items.summary: Iran officially accused the US and regional allies of violating the ceasefire after Thursday's exchange of fire. Iran had been reviewing a US peace proposal that sources said would formally end the war — but the proposal left key US demands (nuclear suspension, Hormuz reopening) unresolved.

items.headline: Contradictory US Messaging: Trump Claims 'Very Good Talks' While Strikes Resume
items.summary: Trump said his administration had 'very good talks' with Tehran in the last 24 hours even as fighting resumed. Earlier this week, Secretary Rubio declared Operation Epic Fury 'concluded' and its objectives met. Iran simultaneously offered conflicting signals, creating extreme uncertainty.

items.headline: Trump Withdraws 5,000 US Troops From Germany After Merz Criticized Iran Talks
items.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's public criticism that the US was being 'humiliated' by Iran in negotiations triggered Trump's decision to pull 5,000 US troops from Germany — a significant transatlantic rift on top of the war itself.

items.headline: Russia Resumes Aerial Guided Bomb Attacks on Kramatorsk, Ukraine
items.summary: Russia carried out aerial guided bomb strikes on Kramatorsk in Ukraine's Donetsk region. The Ukraine conflict continues largely in the background as global attention focuses on the Iran situation.

items.headline: Federal Court Strikes Down Trump's 10% Tariffs — 'Wrongly Invoked Decades-Old Trade Law'
items.summary: A 2-1 panel at the Court of International Trade found Trump's 10% across-the-board tariffs illegal after small businesses sued. The court ruled Trump wrongly invoked the International Emergency Economic Powers Act. This is the second major judicial tariff defeat; the administration is expected to appeal to the Supreme Court.

items.headline: Iran Conflict May Have Motivated Trump Dinner Shooting Suspect — US Intel Report
items.summary: An exclusive US intelligence report finds the suspected shooter at a Trump dinner event may have been motivated by the US-Iran conflict, according to Reuters. The finding adds a domestic security dimension to the ongoing war.

items.headline: Major DEA Drug Bust at LA's MacArthur Park — Large-Scale Arrests in Immigrant Neighborhood
items.summary: DEA agents alongside other law enforcement made large-scale drug-related arrests at MacArthur Park in Los Angeles, a densely populated immigrant neighborhood west of downtown LA. This is the same area where federal immigration authorities made a show of force last summer.

items.headline: Tennessee GOP Redistricting Would Crack Memphis Into 3 Districts to Eliminate Last Dem Seat
items.summary: Tennessee Republicans proposed a redistricting map that would split Shelby County (home to majority-Black Memphis) into three different congressional districts — an effort to eliminate the state's lone remaining Democratic-held seat.

items.headline: Rudy Giuliani Out of ICU but Remains Hospitalized
items.summary: Former New York Mayor Rudy Giuliani has been moved out of the ICU but will remain hospitalized, according to a spokesperson.

items.headline: ARSENAL REACH UCL FINAL: Saka Fires Gunners Into First Champions League Final in 20 Years
items.summary: Bukayo Saka's first-half tap-in gave Arsenal a 1-0 home win over Atletico Madrid (2-1 on aggregate), booking their first Champions League final appearance since 2006. Arteta's side kept their ninth clean sheet of the competition and delivered one of the club's greatest nights in years.

items.headline: Arsenal vs PSG: UCL Final Set for May 30 at Puskas Arena, Budapest
items.summary: PSG beat Bayern Munich 1-1 in Munich (6-5 on aggregate) Wednesday to set up an all-time final. Arsenal vs PSG kicks off May 30 at 12 PM ET at Puskas Arena in Budapest. Each club gets 17,200 tickets; Arsenal are expected to be underdogs.

items.headline: Taylor Jenkins Unveiled as New Milwaukee Bucks Head Coach
items.summary: Taylor Jenkins was officially introduced as the Bucks' new head coach Thursday. Owner Haslam was candid with Jenkins that Giannis 'may or may not be with us.' Jenkins said he's had 'great communication with Giannis' since arriving.

items.headline: Premier League Title Race: Arsenal Leads Man City by 3 Points With 4 Games Left
items.summary: Arsenal (76 pts) leads Man City by 3 points with 4 games left. Three wins from remaining games clinch the title. Man City have a game in hand. Arsenal can clinch as early as May 18 at home to Burnley. The Double (title + UCL final) is in reach.

items.headline: Bucks Set Pre-Draft Giannis Decision Deadline — Miami Heat Eye Trade
items.summary: Bucks owner Haslam: 'Before the draft (June 23) is a natural time. If Giannis does play somewhere else, we ought to get a lot of assets.' Miami Heat are reportedly preparing a revamped trade offer for the Freak.

items.headline: Packers Trade RB David Montgomery to Texans, Acquire OL Juice Scruggs
items.summary: Green Bay traded running back David Montgomery to the Houston Texans in exchange for offensive lineman Juice Scruggs, a 2026 fourth-round pick, and a 2027 seventh-round pick — signaling an OL upgrade focus this offseason.

items.headline: NBA Conference Semifinals: Pistons and Thunder Dominate Game 1
items.summary: Detroit Pistons and OKC Thunder (defending champs) both took commanding Game 1 wins in their Conference Semifinals series, defeating the Cavaliers and Lakers respectively. San Antonio crushed Minnesota Timberwolves 133-95.

items.headline: Arsenal Pursuing Bradley Barcola From PSG in £60M Summer Deal
items.summary: Arsenal have reportedly received encouragement in their pursuit of PSG winger Bradley Barcola, with a £60M bid expected. Notably, this would mean buying from the very team they face in the UCL final — and sources describe Barcola as 'Saka 2.0.'

items.headline: OG Anunoby Day-to-Day With Injury for Knicks Heading Into Conference Semifinals
items.summary: New York Knicks forward OG Anunoby is day-to-day with the injury sustained in Game 2 vs. Philadelphia. His availability is uncertain as the Knicks try to advance in the Conference Semifinals.

items.headline: NFL Offseason: Colts Release Safety Kenny Moore After Trade Request, Rookie Signings Begin
items.summary: Indianapolis Colts released veteran safety Kenny Moore after granting his trade request with no takers. The Tampa Bay Buccaneers signed first-round DE Rueben Bain Jr. to his rookie deal — signaling the 2026 post-draft roster-building phase is now underway.

items.headline: Champions League Final: Arsenal vs PSG, May 30 in Budapest — Ticket Info and Preview
items.summary: Arsenal face PSG at Puskas Arena in Budapest on May 30 (12 PM ET). Each club gets 17,200 tickets; 39,000 of 61,400 total are available to the public. PSG beat Bayern 6-5 on aggregate in a wild semifinal. Arsenal are expected to be underdogs but their defensive solidity (9 clean sheets) gives them a real chance.

items.headline: How Arsenal Got Here: Arteta's 9 Clean Sheets, Saka's Clutch Goal, Rice's Defensive Heroics
items.summary: The Athletic breaks down how a defensive masterclass — led by Rice, 9 competition clean sheets, and Saka's tap-in at the death — carried Arsenal to their first final in 20 years. Arteta's style of football could be the 'perfect antidote' to PSG's free-flowing attack.

items.headline: PL Title Still in Play — Arsenal Could Clinch May 18 vs. Burnley at Home
items.summary: Arsenal (76 pts) leads Man City by 3 points, with 4 games left. Three wins clinch the title. Man City have a game in hand which complicates things, but Arsenal's goal difference (+4 better than City) is an added cushion. Double is very much on.

items.headline: Arsenal Visit West Ham This Sunday May 10 — Next Premier League Test
items.summary: First-place Arsenal travel to West Ham on Sunday, May 10 at 11:30 AM ET (USA Network/Telemundo). A win would maintain the 3-point lead over City with 3 games remaining after this one.

items.headline: Arsenal Targeting Bradley Barcola From PSG in £60M Summer Move
items.summary: In an ironic twist ahead of the UCL final against PSG, Arsenal are reportedly pursuing PSG winger Bradley Barcola. Receiving 'encouragement,' the Gunners are eyeing a £60M bid for the player described as 'Saka 2.0' — creative, fast, and clinical on the left.

items.headline: Taylor Jenkins Era Officially Begins — Introduced as Bucks Head Coach
items.summary: Taylor Jenkins was unveiled as Milwaukee's new head coach Thursday. Owner Haslam told reporters he was upfront with Jenkins: 'He (Giannis) may or may not be with us, so don't come because of that.' Jenkins confirmed 'great communication' with Giannis since arriving.

items.headline: Haslam Sets June 23 Pre-Draft Deadline for Giannis Future Decision
items.summary: Bucks co-owner Jimmy Haslam: 'Before the draft (June 23) is a natural time. Because if Giannis does play somewhere else, we ought to get a lot of assets.' The organization is working with Giannis over the coming weeks to determine what the future looks like for both sides.

items.headline: Miami Heat Planning Revamped Trade Offer for Giannis This Summer
items.summary: The Miami Heat are reportedly preparing a new, more aggressive trade package for Giannis Antetokounmpo ahead of the June 23 draft deadline. Miami is viewed as one of the leading suitors for the two-time MVP.

items.headline: Celtics Showed Only 'Cursory Interest' in Giannis Trade — Not a Serious Pursuit
items.summary: Per Hoops Rumors' Bobby Marks, the Boston Celtics only expressed 'cursory interest' in a Giannis-for-Jaylen Brown type scenario ahead of the February trade deadline. The Celtics are not considered serious suitors.

items.headline: Bucks GM Outlines 2026 NBA Draft Strategy Amid Giannis Uncertainty
items.summary: Bucks GM Jon Horst outlined the team's approach to the June 23 draft, acknowledging the organization needs clarity on Giannis first to determine whether to optimize for assets in a trade or begin a new chapter of contention.

youtube.title: Full Guide: Build An AI Second Brain With Codex
youtube.creator: Matt Wolfe
youtube.summary: Matt Wolfe walks through a complete guide to building an AI-powered second brain using Codex. Covers setting up AI agents, knowledge ingestion pipelines, and practical workflows for personal productivity. Directly relevant for anyone building personal AI automation systems.

youtube.title: AI News: 18 Breaking Stories You Missed This Week
youtube.creator: Matt Wolfe
youtube.summary: Matt Wolfe rounds up 18 AI news stories from the past week — coverage includes DeepSeek V4, new model releases from major labs, and tools updates. Good weekly digest format for staying current on the fast-moving AI landscape.
